# Technical Education Specialist

Company: Notion
Location: New York, NY (hybrid) / Remote US considered
Compensation: $120,000 - $160,000 base

Notion is hiring a Technical Education Specialist to turn a complex product into understandable learning experiences for customers and internal teams.

## Responsibilities

- Design and deliver technical education: onboarding, implementation guides, workshops, and self-service documentation.
- Translate product workflows into walkthroughs, tutorials, and learner-facing materials for nontechnical users.
- Run needs assessments with subject-matter experts; iterate content from learner feedback.
- Build AI-assisted content workflows and learning transfer measurement for education programs.
- Partner with product, support, and customer education on coverage gaps.

## Requirements

- Instructional design, technical writing, customer education, or learning-experience design experience.
- Evidence of live training, workshops, and documentation that reduced time-to-proficiency.
- Comfort with AI-assisted content workflows, knowledge systems, and product education.
- Strong written communication and stakeholder coordination.
- Background in learning design, adult learning, or education technology is a plus.

This is a technical education / learning-product role, not a classroom K-12 teaching role.
